wiki.title: Sue Errington
wiki.extract: Sue E. Errington (born 1942) is a Democratic member of the Indiana House of Representatives representing District 34 (Muncie). She is a former member of the Indiana Senate, representing the 26th District from 2006 to 2010. Prior to holding elected office she served 17 years as the Public Policy Director for Planned Parenthood of Indiana. Sue was married to Dr. Paul Errington, a professor emeritus of physics at Ball State University who died in 2016 and has two adult children.
